badge: Now recruiting agents in New Cairo
title: Build your real estate career with a professional agency
body: ElSakka is a virtual real estate agency. We verify, train, and qualify our agents, then give them the property information and leads they need to close with confidence.

benefits.b1: Curated developments with up-to-date specifications and prices
benefits.b2: Qualified leads assigned directly to you

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: A clear, four-step path from application to your first assigned lead.

s1.title: Verify your identity
s1.body: Confirm your phone over WhatsApp and submit your national ID securely.

s2.title: Record a short interview
s2.body: Introduce yourself in a one-minute video, recorded right in the app.

s3.title: Train and qualify
s3.body: Complete focused training courses and pass the qualification quiz.

s4.title: Start selling
s4.body: Access premium New Cairo developments, current pricing, and leads assigned to you.

cta.title: Ready to join ElSakka?
cta.body: Download the app and apply in about ten minutes.
